# temps_blob (Resource)

Turns on Temps' built-in object storage (S3-compatible) service, which Temps runs as a container and offers to every project. Destroying the resource turns it off: Temps stops the container but keeps it and its data, so enabling the service again resumes it. Name its container with `temps_blob_settings` first if another Temps instance shares the Docker host.

Import with `blob`.

Required API key permissions: `blob:read`, `blob:write`, `blob:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_blob_settings" "this" {
  container_name = "temps-blob-main"
}

resource "temps_blob" "this" {
  depends_on = [temps_blob_settings.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `docker_image` (String) Image to run; Temps picks its default when unset. Changing it upgrades in place.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Administrator password of the store. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `root_user` (String) Administrator user of the store. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `healthy` (Boolean) Whether the service answers health checks.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `blob`.
- `version` (String) Version of the running service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_blob.this blob
```
